jobs.title: Biz Ops Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

As our Biz Ops Lead, you'll build the operational and analytical foundation that scales AirOps to $100M and beyond. This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role — part operator, part strategist, part builder — where no task is too small and no problem is too ambiguous. You'll systematize the repetitive, sprint into the strategic, and help the business run faster and smarter at every layer.

What you’ll do

  • Build and own the operating cadences that keep AirOps aligned and moving — Annual Planning, WBRs, OKRs, etc.

  • Design AI-native workflows across Deal Desk, Business Reporting, and workspace management using AirOps, Claude, and other tools

  • Embed into functions for 2–4 week strategic sprints — diagnosing problems, structuring solutions, and driving them to completion

  • Own deep analytical work - leadership reporting to deep-dive analyses across pricing, customer cohorts, sales capacity, strategic forecasting etc.

  • Identify and size new opportunities — verticals, pricing motions, expansion plays — with clear unit economics and a path to execution

  • Manage core operational infrastructure: compliance, vendor management, and G&A services

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, chief of staff, or business operations role in a high-growth environment.

  • Highly analytical — you build revenue models, cohort analyses, pricing tests, and capacity scenarios from scratch, and turn data into clear recommendations

  • Automation-native — you reach for AI tools instinctively, vibe-code workflows, and eliminate manual work wherever you find it

  • Systems-oriented — you instinctively turn recurring work into structured frameworks, not one-off solutions

  • Fast context-switcher — you embed into a new function and contribute meaningfully within days

  • Strategy and execution-focused — you drive projects to completion and own outcomes, not just facilitate meetings

  • Comfortable across functions — you move fluidly across finance, GTM, and product without losing clarity or momentum

  • Strong communicator — equally crisp writing an exec summary or facilitating a leadership offsite

  • Low-ego — you take the unglamorous work as seriously as the high-visibility stuff

  • Thrive in ambiguity — you bring structure, prioritization, and velocity to fast-moving environments.

Bonus:

  • Shipped something with AI — built a workflow, tool, or automation that people actually used

  • Revenue strategy exposure — you understand how dollars flow through the business, from pricing and packaging to pipeline and margin

  • High-growth SaaS experience — you've seen the $10M–$100M ARR inflection points firsthand

Our Guiding Principles

  1. Extreme Ownership

  2. Quality

  3. Curiosity and Play

  4. Make Our Customers Heroes

  5. Respectful Candor

Benefits

  • Equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

  • Flexible time off policy

  • Parental Leave

  • A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Designer who's excited about shaping the future of AI Search. In this role, you'll build products that help brands succeed as AI agents become the main way people discover them. You'll own large portions of our platform experience - from search visibility tools to last-mile editing experiences - that are fundamentally changing how marketing teams drive revenue in the AI era.

You thrive on moving fast while tackling complex information architecture challenges. You'll prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor and Figma Make, working directly with content and marketing teams to build intuitive and delightful experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end product design for core platform features, from initial concept through launch and iteration based on user feedback

  • Partner with product and engineering leads to translate AI search visibility challenges into elegant design solutions that content teams actually want to use

  • Design intuitive workflows for complex tasks like content gap analysis, AI agent optimization, and multi-channel content publishing

  • Create information hierarchies and data visualizations that make sense of large datasets without overwhelming users

  • Build and maintain our design system while establishing patterns that scale across different user personas and use cases

  • Conduct user research with content teams, SEO professionals, and marketing leaders to understand their workflows and pain points

  • Prototype rapidly to test assumptions and validate design decisions with real users before engineering investment

  • Collaborate with customer success to understand how teams actually use our platform and where they get stuck

  • Help define product strategy by identifying opportunities where better design can directly impact customer outcomes

  • Mentor junior designers and contribute to building a design culture focused on measurable business impact

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product design experience with at least 3 years working on B2B SaaS platforms

  • Portfolio demonstrating your ability to simplify complex workflows and data-heavy interfaces

  • Experience designing for technical audiences while maintaining accessibility for non-technical users

  • Strong understanding of content management systems, SEO tools, or marketing technology platforms

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git

  • Track record of shipping products that directly impact business metrics and user adoption

  • Ability to work autonomously while actively seeking feedback and collaboration

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate design decisions to stakeholders

  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to define structure where none exists

  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing search, content discovery, and digital marketing

Our Guiding Principles

  1. Extreme Ownership

  2. Quality

  3. Curiosity and Play

  4. Make Our Customers Heroes

  5. Respectful Candor

Benefits

  • Equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Competitive benefits package tailored to your location

  • Flexible time off policy

  • Parental Leave

  • A fun-loving and (just a bit) nerdy team that loves to move fast!

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at AirOps, you’ll work directly with enterprise clients to turn AI search and growth strategy into measurable outcomes. You’ll use the AirOps platform to configure, adapt, and scale playbooks that help leading brands stay visible and competitive as discovery shifts across AI search engines.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who likes being close to the customer, the product, and the impact. You’ll partner across Product, Customer Success, Sales, Growth, and Marketing to deliver repeatable client outcomes, bring field feedback back into the platform, and help shape a more mature delivery motion as AirOps scales.


What you'll own

  • Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their goals, translate them into clear delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes across AI search visibility and growth

  • Configure, adapt, and scale AirOps playbooks across customer accounts and verticals, helping turn repeatable delivery patterns into stronger product and service motions

  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Sales, Growth, and Marketing to align customer needs, product capabilities, and expansion opportunities

  • Monitor performance data, identify trends and risks, and communicate recommendations to customers and internal stakeholders

  • Bring field feedback back into the product and delivery teams to improve the AirOps platform, customer experience, and future playbooks

What you'll bring

  • 4 to 7 years in Growth, BizOps, Product, Technical Account Management, Analytics, Solutions, Customer Success, or a similar role at a high-growth startup

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers, translating business goals into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, LLMs, prompt engineering, or automation platforms to improve processes and scale repeatable work

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify patterns, and turn insights into recommendations

  • Excellent project management and communication skills, with the ability to keep internal teams and customers aligned across multiple workstreams

  • High ownership, strong judgment, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where customer needs, product feedback, and delivery priorities intersect

  • Familiarity with AI search, GEO/AEO strategy, or how brands are discovered across LLMs and answer engines

  • Experience at an early or growth-stage B2B SaaS company

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

AirOps is hiring an Insights Strategist to analyze AI Search data and turn it into insights that support product decisions and customer guidance. This person will identify the questions worth answering, develop the analysis needed to answer them, and communicate the findings clearly.

The role combines recurring analysis with focused investigation. The Insights Strategist will build ongoing reporting that tracks changes in brand visibility, citations, sentiment, source patterns, and model behavior over time. They will also initiate deeper analyses when the data reveals a material shift or an unexplained result.

This role requires independent judgment about what to analyze and how to translate the results into decisions. The Insights Strategist will work closely with Product and Data to improve AirOps’ metrics, reporting, and product experience. They will also help customer-facing teams apply the findings in conversations with customers and prospects.

What you’ll do

  • Identify the questions AirOps should be answering with its AI Search data, based on product priorities, customer needs, and changes in the market.

  • Develop recurring analyses that track AI Search performance across models, topics, brands, and time periods.

  • Lead focused investigations into changes in visibility, citations, sentiment, source patterns, and model behavior.

  • Develop and refine the metrics and analytical methods AirOps uses to measure AI Search performance.

  • Translate findings into recommendations that inform product priorities, customer strategy, and prospect conversations.

  • Partner with Product and Data to improve the quality, accessibility, and usefulness of AirOps’ data and reporting.

  • Create clear, customer-ready analyses, presentations, and benchmarks without overstating what the evidence supports.

  • Present findings to internal teams, customers, and prospects, adapting the level of detail to the audience.

  • Document analytical methods, assumptions, and limitations so that important analyses can be repeated and trusted.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in insights, analytics, product strategy, data science, consulting, or a related analytical role.

  • A track record of defining analytical questions and setting priorities, rather than working only from requests created by other teams.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working directly with large, complex, or imperfect datasets.

  • Sound analytical judgment, including the ability to select appropriate methods and distinguish a useful signal from an unsupported conclusion.

  • Experience building recurring reporting or measurement systems alongside deeper, one-time analyses.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to business and executive audiences.

  • Experience turning analysis into specific recommendations for product teams, customers, or senior leaders.

  • Comfort working across Product, Data, Sales, Customer Success, and other functions in a fast-moving environment.

  • Experience with AI Search, search analytics, SEO, AEO, large language models, or recommendation systems.

  • Experience analyzing text-heavy or unstructured datasets.

  • Familiarity with Python, R, notebooks, or business intelligence tools in addition to SQL.

  • Experience working with B2B SaaS, data products, or analytics platforms.

  • Customer-facing experience in strategy, consulting, solutions, or insights roles.

  • Experience developing benchmarks, measurement frameworks, or analytical methodologies used across multiple customers.

  • Implement legal technology, automation, and AI-assisted workflows to improve speed, consistency, and visibility.

  • Oversee insurance, disputes, compliance, risk management, and regulatory matters.
